module.purpose: Defines the canonical string-coded error identifiers used to classify application failures across package boundaries.
module.summary: This module centralizes stable error codes as a string-valued enumeration. It provides a single vocabulary for payment, booking, availability, scheduling, subscription, and OAuth-related failures, allowing callers and downstream error handlers to exchange consistent machine-readable identifiers.
module.businessContext: Supports booking and payment workflows by standardizing failure identifiers. Changes can break client error handling, API integrations, and operational diagnosis.
classes: ErrorCode (~L1-25): Enumerates stable identifiers for application error responses
